title: Signature Spellbook: Gideon: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "One life at a time. That is how the world will be saved."
"Heroism is more than a single act; it is hundreds of small decisions, made every day, in pursuit of a heroic cause."
Even after all that befell Amonkhet, Gideon never believed that his trust in Oketra was misplaced.
A weapon of evil, redeemed in Gideon's hand.
